name: Reunified Germany
concept: The two German states reunited under one government, ending the division of Europe's heartland.

name: United Korea
concept: Peaceful or forced reunification of the Korean peninsula under one government.

name: Reunified Vietnam
concept: One Vietnam from the Chinese border to the Mekong delta, as the 1954 Geneva accords once promised through elections.

name: Maphilindo
concept: A confederation of the Malay peoples of Malaya, the Philippines and Indonesia (Macapagal's proposal).

name: Federation of Malaysia
concept: Malaya federated with Singapore, North Borneo (Sabah) and Sarawak, as planned in London for 1963.

name: Expanded United Arab Republic
concept: Nasser's union revived and enlarged: Egypt, Syria and the new Yemeni republic under one flag.

name: Pan-Arab Union
concept: A single Arab state from the Atlantic to the Gulf, the dream of Nasserists and Ba'athists alike.

name: Arab Federation
concept: The Hashemite union of Iraq and Jordan (1958), restored as a counterweight to Nasser.

name: Union of African States
concept: The Ghana-Guinea-Mali union turned into a real federation, the nucleus of Nkrumah's United States of Africa.

name: Greater Somalia
concept: All Somali-inhabited lands united: Somalia plus the Ogaden (Ethiopia), Kenya's Northern Frontier District and French Somaliland.

name: West Indies Federation
concept: Revival of the British Caribbean federation dissolved in May 1962, with Jamaica, Trinidad and the smaller islands.

name: Central African Federation
concept: The Federation of Rhodesia and Nyasaland preserved and recast, or extended, as a multiracial dominion.

name: East African Federation
concept: Tanganyika, Kenya, Uganda and Zanzibar federated, as Nyerere proposed (he offered to delay independence for it).

name: Balkan Federation
concept: Tito's old plan of a socialist federation of Yugoslavia, Bulgaria and Albania.

name: Nordic Union
concept: A Scandinavian defence and economic union, as discussed in 1948-49.
